assets.name: umber-hall
assets.description: A dim great hall of lime plaster over umber: mottled, damp-stained plaster in umber and backdrop-warm, a faint ochre wash where the light falls, and a dark timber dado with a worn cap rail low behind the shoulders.

assets.name: green-arras
assets.description: A worn verdure tapestry (arras) of forest and deep vert hung in heavy vertical folds, with faded millefleur sprigs in moss, ochre and oxblood, threadbare patches showing the warp, and a faded oxblood-and-ochre border along the top.

assets.name: oxblood-chamber
assets.description: A close privy chamber hung with oxblood wool-velvet damask: a faint ogee pomegranate repeat, vertical panel seams, pile rubbed thin and brownish where it has worn, sinking into umber at the edges.

assets.name: stone-apse
assets.description: A chapel apse of cool grey-umber ashlar: a round-headed niche behind the head with radial voussoirs, coursed blocks each a slightly different stone, dark worn mortar joints, and the concave inner wall catching the light on its right side.

assets.name: oak-gallery
assets.description: A long gallery wainscoted in dark oak: raised-and-fielded panels framed by stiles and rails, upper-left bevels catching light and lower-right bevels in shadow, long vertical grain in the stiles and panels, and a heavy cornice in shadow along the top.
